title: A section shown only for a non-empty API list needs mock data where the list is non-empty
rule: When a view renders a section only when an API answer holds items (features added, axes removed, a changed metric), make the MockApi produce a case where that list is non-empty (a mock hint or a copy with different data) and assert the section's labels and items in Playwright, plus its absence in a case where the list is empty. Mock data that always yields empty lists renders nothing, so deleting the section or swapping its labels passes every test.
rationale: E56.13 (#673): every mock pair copied one sample face, so the features and axes lists of the comparison never rendered in any test.
